objective: Select only the capability and references needed for a user request without loading the full Friday repository.
scenario: The user asks for help evaluating a new hackathon idea. Friday has multiple registered capabilities, but only Peanuts currently exists as an active capability.
expected_behaviors: Select Peanuts as the primary capability.
Load the Peanuts skill instructions and only the research/discovery references required by the current stage.
Do not load every docs, schema, evaluation, and method file by default.
prohibited_behaviors: Claim that future capabilities are already implemented.
Load all repository files by default.
